hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to pieces per whole is $\tealE9:5$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ pieces per whole.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | ${9}$ | $\stackrel{\times 20}\rightarrow$ | ${180}$
Parts per whole | $5$ | $\stackrel{\times 20}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\tealE{180}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.
